title: Fallout 3 — Vault112a Blind Spatial-Neighborhood Reference-Graph Gate v2.3

problem_found.finding: The v2.0 exporter assigns HardwareKind and exits before export when kind=OTHER. An unnamed or generically named ACTI/STAT/MSTT/local-processing prop can therefore be absent from the hardware TSV even when physically adjacent to every Visiontron.
problem_found.impact: The real per-lounger shard could be missed because discovery was partially dependent on base/ref identity text before spatial analysis.

design: Export every winning REFR in CELL Vault112a without name, signature or hardware-kind prefiltering.
Preserve base signature/FormID/EditorID/name/model, exact XYZ, scripts, enable parent, owner, disabled state and full record path.
Identify James monitor and Visiontron anchors only after the exhaustive cell export.
Assign each non-Visiontron reference to its uniquely nearest Visiontron within the audit radius; equidistant objects remain visible but do not contribute to repeating-layout admission.
Rank blind neighbors per Visiontron and detect repeated base FormIDs across distinct loungers even when EditorID/name are empty.
Never promote proximity or repetition to functional wiring, state ownership, persistence or memory-carrier status.

admission_ladder.meaning: James monitor has geometric Visiontron candidate
Unnamed/generic base repeats in uniquely-nearest neighborhoods of multiple Visiontrons
James Visiontron participates in the same repeated generic-base pattern
Primary ESM links/scripts/reverse refs bind candidate to resident/session state
Primary semantics prove persistence/addressability and later carrier edge

required_cases: Unnamed generic ACTI repeated around separate Visiontrons is surfaced.
Generic STAT and MSTT objects are not discarded.
Distinct bases do not form a false repeated-base candidate.
Object outside radius does not contribute.
Visiontron cannot be its own neighbor.
Duplicate RefID and nonnumeric coordinates fail closed.
James repeated neighbor remains candidate only.
No spatial result auto-promotes memory persistence.

save_james_effect.reason: The search tooling can no longer miss an unnamed per-lounger shard solely because the object lacks computer-like naming, but no real ESM TSV has yet established a James-specific persistent backend handle.

next_gate.name: REAL_ESM_VAULT112A_BLIND_ALL_REFR_SPATIAL_RECEIPT_v2.1
required_sequence: Load exactly Fallout3.esm, Anchorage.esm, ThePitt.esm, BrokenSteel.esm, PointLookout.esm and Zeta.esm in FO3Edit.
Run verify_vault112_blind_spatial_neighborhood_v2_1.py and freeze its JSON result.
Inspect repeated unnamed/generic bases around all Visiontrons and especially the James-associated Visiontron.
For any James repeated-blind candidate, return to primary ESM and resolve scripts, enable parents, ownership, linked records and reverse references.
Promote only if primary record semantics establish James-specific state ownership/persistence.
